description: This file defines internal utility structures and functions for handling function references and invocations within the Abseil C++ library, including type erasure, argument passing optimization, and null checks.

classes.name: VoidPtr
classes.description: A union that can hold either a const void pointer or a function pointer, used for type erasure.

classes.name: PassByValue
classes.description: Template struct to determine if a type should be passed by value based on trivial copy and destructibility traits.

classes.name: ForwardT
classes.description: Template alias to decide whether to pass a type by value or rvalue reference.

methods.name: InvokeObject
methods.description: Static function to invoke a callable object with given arguments.

methods.name: InvokeFunction
methods.description: Static function to invoke a function pointer with given arguments.

methods.name: AssertNonNull
methods.description: Overloaded template functions to assert that function objects or pointers are not null.
